title: Clearance
line: Move a piece out of the way of another.

steps.text: Your knight stands on the square your rook wants, and the pawn on h7 shuts the file. One knight check fixes both.
Clear the square: move the knight away with check, even where a pawn can take it.
steps.hint: The knight can check the king in the corner.
steps.after: The pawn took the knight, and the square is free.

steps.text: The same idea for Black: your knight stands on the square your queen wants, and the pawn on h2 shuts the file.
Clear the square with a knight check.

summary: Sometimes your own piece stands on the square another one needs. Move it away with a threat, and the square is free.
